data.body:
Find reusable components by logical folder, tag or search and recognize them from static thumbnails. Follow the approved Library UX brief.

Reuse shared component IDs/revisions/store. Folder and tag edits do not relocate source or create executable revisions. Preserve old catalogs, linked scenes, concurrent updates and package/fallback transfer. Provide accessible search/filter/sort, clear empty states and narrow/wide browsing. Use bounded revision-specific optional thumbnails and placeholders; never eagerly render the whole library. Expose concise organization metadata through existing MCP/default catalog without preview bytes.

Checklist: implement; demonstrate organizing an existing entry, finding it, reopening Studio and retaining linked-scene behavior; independent source/actual UI review; integrate and install/check skill. Preserve user components.

Schedule after first usable LUX151 audio demo and responsive Library fix. Resolume export QA is deferred.
Reference: artifacts/library-organization-brief.md.
